value.name: announce codicil filing
value.description: Asha reports that the codicil was lodged with the Register of Wills and the petition to admit it has been docketed, making the estate legally administered under the February 11 will.
evidence: the codicil was lodged this morning at eight forty-five with the Register of Wills, and the petition to admit it has been docketed.
The estate is now, for all legal purposes, being administered under the will of February eleventh.

value.name: withdraw sale after notice
value.description: Asha says she notified the buyers' attorney the previous evening, received a brief call back this morning, and the contemplated sale has been withdrawn.
evidence: I sent the notice to the buyers' attorney at nine last evening, and I had a brief and civil call from him at seven thirty this morning, and the contemplated sale is, as of last night, withdrawn.
value.time_hint: nine last evening / seven thirty this morning / as of last night

value.name: report halloran approval
value.description: Asha relays that Mr. Halloran reviewed the file, is satisfied with the estate's posture, and sends condolences and personal regards to Ms. Maldonado.
evidence: Mr. Halloran has reviewed the file and is satisfied with the posture of the estate, and he sends his condolences to the family and his particular regards to Ms. Maldonado

value.name: recall christmas dinner
value.description: Rosa reacts to Halloran's memory by noting that he has a good memory and identifying the Christmas event as the year they did the lamb.
evidence: "He has a good memory," she said.
"That was the year we did the lamb."

value.name: acknowledge lamb memory
value.description: Asha confirms that Halloran mentioned the lamb, and Rosa accepts the exchange with a brief assent.

value.name: open settlement folder
value.description: Asha opens the folder to begin discussing how the co-owned house will be handled.

value.name: outline ownership process
value.description: Asha tells the three owners that they now own the house together and proposes focusing on process rather than immediate outcome.
evidence: "What I would like to do this morning," she said, "is talk about process. Not yet about outcome. The three of you now own this house together."

value.name: propose two-week plan
value.description: Asha proposes that the group agree on the next two weeks instead of choosing a final resolution immediately.
evidence: there is no reason to choose among them today.
What there is reason to do today is agree on the next two weeks.

value.name: present memorandum sequence
value.description: Asha explains that she has drafted a memorandum laying out the next steps, including an independent appraisal, an inventory of contents, and a meeting two weeks later.
evidence: I have drafted a short document — it is not a contract, it is a memorandum — that lays out a sequence.
Independent appraisal. Inventory of contents. A meeting two weeks from today
